parameters.query: SELECT c.id, c.email, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.company, c.client_id, c.custom_fields, c.created_at, 'birthday' as event_type, c.custom_fields->>'birthday' as event_date FROM contacts c WHERE c.lead_status NOT IN ('lost') AND c.custom_fields->>'birthday' IS NOT NULL AND TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'MM-DD') = SUBSTRING(c.custom_fields->>'birthday', 6, 5) UNION ALL SELECT c.id, c.email, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.company, c.client_id, c.custom_fields, c.created_at, 'anniversary' as event_type, c.created_at::text as event_date FROM contacts c WHERE c.lead_status NOT IN ('lost') AND TO_CHAR(c.created_at, 'MM-DD') = TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'MM-DD') AND c.created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '365 days' UNION ALL SELECT c.id, c.email, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.company, c.client_id, c.custom_fields, c.created_at, 'trial_expiring' as event_type, c.custom_fields->>'trial_end_date' as event_date FROM contacts c WHERE c.lead_status = 'opportunity' AND c.custom_fields->>'trial_end_date' IS NOT NULL AND (c.custom_fields->>'trial_end_date')::date = CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '3 days'

INSERT INTO lead_activities (contact_id, activity_type, activity_data, score_impact) VALUES ({{ $json.id }}, 'event_email_sent', '{"event_type": "{{ $json.event_type }}", "template": "{{ $json.template_id }}"}'::jsonb, {{ $json.score_impact }}); UPDATE contacts SET lead_score = lead_score + {{ $json.score_impact }} WHERE id = {{ $json.id }};
